name: Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
briefDescription: The scheme “Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme (CMDPS)” was started by the Women & Child Welfare Department, Govt. of Sikkim to provide financial assistance to the differently abled person who has a disability of 40% and above.
descriptionMd: The scheme “Chief Minister&#39;s State Disability Pension Scheme (CMDPS)” was started by the Women &amp; Child Welfare Department, Govt. of Sikkim to provide financial assistance to the differently abled person who has a disability of 40% and above. This scheme is 100% State Innovative Scheme and the beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of ₹ 1500/-.
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant should be a resident of the state of Sikkim.
1. The applicant with 40% and above disability is eligible for the scheme.
1. The applicant should belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
1. The applicant should not be covered under Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS).
1. The applicant should have opened the Bank Account under “Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana”.
